Notes: IRID011 and IRID038 were excluded (no HTLV-1 clones detected)

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ineq, tidyplots)

gini_index <- function(counts) {
  n <- length(counts)
  mean_count <- mean(counts)
  sum_abs_diff <- sum(sapply(counts, function(x) sum(abs(x - counts))))
  gini <- sum_abs_diff / (2 * n^2 * mean_count)
  return(gini)
}

htlv_is = read_tsv("concatenated_output.txt", col_names = c("range", "chrom", "start", "end", "freq", "freq_p", "sample"))
result <- htlv_is |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  summarise(gini = Gini(freq), .groups = 'drop') |>
  filter(gini>0.4)

result <- htlv_is |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  group_split() |>
  map_dfr(~ tibble(sample = .x$sample[1], gini = Gini(.x$freq))) |>
  filter(gini<.2)

result <- htlv_is |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  group_split() |>
  map_dfr(~ tibble(sample = .x$sample[1], 
            gini = gini_index(.x$freq),
            sum_freq = sum(.x$freq))) |>
  tidyplot(x=gini, y=sum_freq) |>
  add_data_points()

print(result)
show(result)

```
